Working on statistics, applied mathematics, and machine learning.

I use this site to think through statistical geometry, uncertainty, high-dimensional effects, and small empirical diagnostics.

These are notes and experiments — things worth writing down.

## Independence

This is a personal academic site. The views, writing, examples, code, and experiments published here are my own and do not represent my employer. Material is produced independently, outside work duties, using public sources, publicly available software, and personal resources. It does not contain confidential information, client data, internal materials, or non-public employer know-how.
